proofs.name: tracing-overhead-benchmark
proofs.description: docs/phase-16-plan.md §19/§22: a `go test -bench` comparing RunOnce throughput with tracing disabled vs. enabled against a real, locally-run OTLP collector, committed as evidence per this project's 'measure before documenting' discipline. This requires an external OTLP collector process Autopilot's local-gates runner does not stand up automatically, and the benchmark's exact package/name do not exist prior to this phase's own implementation -- so it cannot be registered as a pinned, pre-existing command proof. A human must run it and confirm the committed benchmark evidence exists and reflects the tracing-enabled vs. disabled comparison the plan requires before approving this obligation.
